The filter properly clean the water OK and how long it will last still has to be seen, as it was installed 5 days ago. However, the water only came out as a little trickle. The fix was to cut a small washer about 0.030" thick and with an inner diameter the size of the nozzle, and a brim width of about 3/16" and install it before you screw the filter in place. The tabs on the filter, which opens the two small water valves, are either not high enough or not in the exact (correct) location to push the valve tabs in for fully open the valves.

It does the basics well. Improvement needed: curb its flow rate (water jets out like a laser). Comparing the overall filterage to a premium brand may
be a losing endeavor.

Great value and a good product. I have a GE French Door Refrigerator/bottom freezer with no water dispenser, just an ice maker. My ice was starting to taste a little funky so it was time to change the filter. I couldn't believe the price of an OEM GE filter so I started looking at the various Amazon after market options and came upon this one whose price was right and the reviews rock solid.
I had some concerns when I read the instructions that they recommend running a couple of gallons through the water dispenser to clean out any loose particles due to the manufacturing process since I don't have a water dispenser. I installed the filter and emptied out the ice drawer and surprisingly, no issues with the taste of the new ice nor any particles that I can detect. I figured at this price, I don't have anything to lose even if they only last 6 months since I could go 2 years and still pay less that what a GE branded filter would cost.
